---
name: Broken / changed engine
about: An engine returns errors or no suggestions
labels: engine
---

**Engine id:** (e.g. `amazon`)
**Where:** Web app (local server) / CLI
**Language / country:** (e.g. pt-br / br)
**Example query:** use a neutral, synthetic example (e.g. `converter pdf em word`) — never a strategic query of yours
**Error shown:** (hover the engine chip in the stats bar to see it)
**Error message only:** do not paste collected suggestions, `npm run check` output, Search Console data or internal URLs (this repository is public)
